info.name: Bonderud Law Firm API - Complete Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for Bonderud Law Firm - Bilingual (English/Spanish) REST API

## Features
- JWT-based authentication with refresh tokens
- Role-based access control (admin, editor, viewer)
- Bilingual content support (English/Spanish)
- Comprehensive user, attorney, and practice area management
- File upload support for media assets
- Advanced search and filtering capabilities

## Authentication
Most endpoints require authentication via JWT Bearer token.
Include the token in the Authorization header: `Bearer <token>`

## Rate Limiting
API requests are limited to 100 requests per 15 minutes per IP address.

## Base URL
- Development: http://localhost:3003/api/v1
- Production: https://api.bonderudlaw.com/api/v1
